name: taskboard
description: A desktop to-do app: Vue renderer, Electron shell, Node.js file-system backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:test: concurrently -k -n VITE,HOST,CLIENT -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development TASKBOARD_DEVTEST_INSTANCE=host electron ." "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development TASKBOARD_DEVTEST_INSTANCE=client electron ."
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
